resources.string: Lets Pinky read the screen and tap, swipe and type for the tasks you start in Pinky on this phone; once you turn it on for them, it stays on until you turn it off here. It also lets Pinky on your computer read the controls on the screen and type text while an agent works on this phone, and tap and swipe on phones that ignore taps sent over USB debugging. Pinky turns this service on over USB debugging only while an agent works here, and off again a few seconds after the task ends or you take over; it also turns itself off a minute after Pinky disconnects. Banking and other apps can see an accessibility service that is on. Turning it off here lasts until the next task; to keep Pinky from using it at all, uninstall this app: Pinky works without it, only more slowly. On phones that don\'t let Pinky turn it on over USB debugging, you turn it on here yourself, and it stays on until you turn it off here.
Pinky turns this service on through adb only while an agent works on this phone, and off again afterwards. Nothing here needs to be set up by hand.
Pinky\'s device tests write into these fields with set_text and read them back.
Posted by the debug page of Pinky.
Notifications are not allowed for this app.
